name: Vaish at Rivoli
address: 25 Regal Building, Next to PVR Rivoli Cinema, Baba Kharak Singh Marg, Connaught Place, New Delhi – 110001
about: A long-running Connaught Place tailoring house making fully hand-worked bespoke suits and shirts for men, founded by O.P. Vaish and now run by later generations of the family.
notes: Address confirmed on own website. Phone, email and opening hours are not published on the heritage page. Own site says the business dates to the World War II era ('75 glorious years') but does not print an exact founding year, so establishedYear left null.

name: Grover Tailors
address: 47A, Khan Market, New Delhi – 110003
about: A Khan Market bespoke tailoring studio cutting business suits, tuxedos, blazers and overcoats for both men and women, alongside ethnic pieces and handcrafted pashmina jackets.
notes: Address, phone, Instagram and 1962 founding year all taken from own website. Opening hours not published.

name: Mr. Fox
address: Defence Colony, New Delhi
about: An appointment-only bespoke menswear atelier founded by Angad Malhotra, cutting a house silhouette that pairs British structure with softer Neapolitan shoulders, plus Indo-formal pieces such as bandhgalas and achkans.
notes: Own site lists only 'Defence Colony, New Delhi' with no street address or pincode; visits are by appointment. Phone shown is the WhatsApp number on the About page. Founding year not stated.

name: Indian Tailoring Company
address: Shankar Market, Connaught Place, New Delhi
about: A bespoke menswear workroom led by Aditya Jain, who trained in Milan and at the Savile Row Academy in London; it occupies a Connaught Place atelier that traces back to a 1938 tailoring shop, and Jain personally takes measurements and cuts patterns.
notes: Two editorial sources place the atelier in Shankar Market / Connaught Place but neither prints a shop number, phone or hours. indiantailoringcompany.com returned empty content when fetched so the website field is left null; an Instagram profile @indiantailoringcompany appears in search results but was not fetched, so it is not recorded.

name: The Darzi
address: A-6, Block A, Rajouri Garden, New Delhi - 110027
about: A made-to-measure menswear house working across formal suits, bandhgalas, tuxedos and sherwanis, with a large in-house team of tailors and a claim to having been among the first in India to computerise its tailoring operations.
notes: Address, phone and 1981 founding year from own website contact page. Opening hours and Instagram not published there.

name: The Darzi - Ambience Mall
address: 120, 1st Floor, NH8 - Ambience Mall, Ambience Island, Gurugram - 122001
about: The Gurugram outlet of The Darzi, offering the same made-to-measure menswear service — suits, bandhgalas, tuxedos and sherwanis — from a mall storefront on NH8.
notes: Second branch of the same company; address and phone from own website contact page. Opening hours not published.

name: Collar by Mridula & Anju
address: H-81, Ground Floor, Main Market, South Extension 1, New Delhi
about: A bespoke menswear label run by designers Mridula and Anju, best known for tailored suits and bandhgalas made to individual measurement.
notes: Address, phone and starting prices from an LBB listicle and may be dated. collarbespoke.com appeared in search results but failed DNS resolution on two fetch attempts, so website left null. An Instagram handle @collarbespokewear and additional Shahpur Jat / Meherchand Market locations appear in search results but were not directly verified, so they are not recorded.

name: Raj Tailors
address: 2576/5, Beadonpura, Ajmal Khan Road, Karol Bagh, New Delhi
about: A Karol Bagh tailoring shop recommended by Delhi customers for made-to-measure men's suits.
notes: Single editorial source only. No website or Instagram found. Address, phone and the INR 10,000 starting price come from an LBB listicle and may be dated; pincode and hours unknown.

name: Roshan Tailors (House of Roshans)
address: M-53, Lower Ground Floor, M Block Market, Greater Kailash 1, New Delhi
about: A Greater Kailash tailoring studio that specialises almost entirely in blouses, including beaded and wedding styles stitched to measure.
notes: Address and phone from an LBB listicle; no independent website or Instagram located. Pincode, hours and prices unknown.

name: Kardo
address: Jungi House, 2nd Floor, 5-G, Shahpur Jat, New Delhi
about: A slow-fashion menswear label whose garments are each made start-to-finish by a single tailor in its Shahpur Jat workshop, using Indian craft textiles such as block prints, ikat, khadi and natural indigo.
notes: Founding year (2013), Instagram and the Shahpur Jat workshop are confirmed on the brand's own site; the Shahpur Jat street address and phone come from LBB and may be dated. Note the company's registered/office address on kardo.co is F21 Sector 8, Noida (phone +91 120 521 2394) — the retail workshop is the Delhi one recorded here.

name: Bhaavya Bhatnagar
address: 139, Ground Floor, Shahpur Jat, New Delhi
about: A Shahpur Jat womenswear label known for structured separates, pant suits and concept saris, with made-to-measure customisation offered on most pieces.
notes: Own site confirms the label, its made-to-measure service and Instagram but publishes no address or phone; the Shahpur Jat address comes from LBB. Pincode and hours unknown.

name: Asiana Couture
address: Katra Hardiyal, 652 & 655, Nai Sarak, Chandni Chowk, New Delhi
about: A Chandni Chowk bridal house selling lehengas, anarkalis and occasion wear across a wide price spread, with appointment-based shopping and sister labels under the same group.
notes: Phone from own website; street address from LBB (own site names only Chandni Chowk). LBB also lists a landline +91 11 4579 4896. Hours, Instagram and founding year not published.

name: Jagdish & Sons
address: 987, Gali Bhojpura Road, Maliwara, Chandni Chowk, New Delhi
about: A long-established Chandni Chowk wedding-wear store stocking bridal and bridesmaid lehengas, designer saris, drape saris, suits and gowns.
notes: Founding year (1961) and Instagram from own site, which does not print an address or phone on the homepage; street address from LBB. Phone, pincode and hours unknown.

name: Madsam Tinzin
address: 5, Kalka Das Marg, Seth Sarai, Mehrauli, New Delhi
about: A Mehrauli boutique working with hand-embroidered silks and contemporary lehenga silhouettes.
notes: Single editorial source. Address and phone from LBB; no website or Instagram located. Pincode, hours and prices unknown.

name: HANI.S by Hanish Sukhija
address: 125, Fashion Lane, Shahpur Jat, New Delhi
about: A Shahpur Jat label focused on occasion and bridal wear, including lehengas, saris and gowns.
notes: Single editorial source. Address and phone from LBB; website/Instagram not verified. Pincode, hours and prices unknown.

name: Kynaa
address: F-1/18, DLF Phase 1, Sector 26A, Gurgaon
about: A multi-designer ethnic wear store in DLF Phase 1 that carries work from a large roster of independent designers, spanning tunics, saris, anarkalis, gowns and lehengas.
notes: Address and phone from LBB. The article notes the store's own website is not kept up to date, so no website is recorded; Instagram handle not stated. Pincode, hours and prices unknown.

name: Chetna Bagga
address: Nirvana Country, Sector 50, Gurgaon
about: A Gurugram womenswear studio built around slow, artisan-made clothing — kurtas, tunics, jackets and ensembles cut from khadi, chanderi, ikat and silk.
notes: Phone and Instagram from own site; the site gives only 'Nirvana Country, Sector 50, Gurgaon' with no house/shop number, so address is incomplete and pincode unknown. The 10 AM - 7 PM window on the site is stated as call/WhatsApp support hours, not store hours, so openingHours left empty.

name: Kapaas by Nikita
address: B-1C, Sector 104, Opposite Sharnam Gate No. 2, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201304
about: A Noida boutique that both sells and stitches ethnic wear — saris, lehengas, suits and Indo-western pieces — with custom tailoring, hand-blocked cottons and remote consultations over video call.
notes: Address, pincode, phone and Instagram all from the business's own website. Hours and founding year not published. Note LBB lists an older Sector 92 address; the Sector 104 address on the current site is used here.

name: HP Singh Fabrics
address: 111, 82-83 Vaikunth Building, Nehru Place, New Delhi - 110019
about: One of the larger fabric retailers in the Nehru Place market, stocking cottons, linens, rayons, silks, wools, knits, embroidered and printed fabrics across a basement showroom, and shipping nationally.
notes: Address, pincode, phone and Instagram from own website. Own site says '40+ years' but gives no founding year, so establishedYear is null. Opening hours not published.

name: Ramji Sons
address: A-11, Lajpat Nagar-2, Feroz Gandhi Marg, New Delhi 110024
about: A Lajpat Nagar fabric studio supplying designers and boutiques with plain and embroidered silks, printed textiles and wedding-wear material, alongside unstitched suits, dupattas and menswear fabric.
notes: Address, pincode, phone and Instagram from own website. Own site claims '35 Years of Excellence' but no founding year. LBB lists a different address (1, Pushpa Central Market, Lajpat Nagar 2) — the own-site address is used here; there may be more than one shop. Hours not published.

name: TradeUNO Fabrics
address: UG-18, Ground Floor, DT Mega Mall, Golf Course Road, A Block, DLF Phase 1, Gurugram, Haryana 122001
about: A Gurugram fabric retailer serving both bespoke customers and wholesale buyers, with cottons, silks, linens, chiffons and occasion fabrics sold by the metre in store and online.
notes: Address, pincode, phone, Instagram and the 10 AM - 7 PM daily hours are all stated on the business's own contact page. A second Gurugram location in Udyog Vihar, Sector 20 is listed without a street address, so it is not recorded separately. Founding year unknown.

name: KC Creations
address: C-8, Central Market, Near Roxy Chowk, Lajpat Nagar 2, New Delhi
about: A multi-floor fabric shop in Lajpat Nagar's Central Market carrying cottons, blends, brocades, silks, chanderis and phulkari, along with a large range of prints.
notes: Address and phone from LBB; no website or Instagram located. Pincode, hours and prices unknown. Lajpat Nagar Central Market is reported closed on Mondays but this was not confirmed for the individual shop, so openingHours left empty.

name: R.G. Jindal & Sons
address: Skyline House, G-2/85, Nehru Place, New Delhi
about: A fabric shop in the Nehru Place cloth market, part of a cluster of stores selling handloom, cotton, silk and synthetic material at close-to-wholesale rates.
notes: Single editorial source with address and phone only. No website or Instagram. Pincode, hours and prices unknown; the fabric range described is that of the market generally, not verified per-shop.

name: Flyrobe
address: F-134, Rajouri Garden, New Delhi
about: An outfit rental service with a Rajouri Garden storefront, renting sherwanis, suits, lehengas and gowns for weddings and events, with fittings handled in store.
notes: Address, hours (11:30 AM - 8:30 PM) and starting price from LBB; the hours are stated without a weekly breakdown so the same window is applied to all days. flyrobe.com was fetched and confirms the rental business but publishes no store address or phone. Additional Gurgaon and South Delhi outlets are mentioned without addresses. Pincode and phone unknown.

name: Stylobe
address: A-22, Central Market, Lajpat Nagar 2, New Delhi
about: A Lajpat Nagar rental store leaning towards ethnic occasion wear for men, including sherwanis and dhoti kurta sets.
notes: Address, phone and starting price from LBB and may be dated. No website or Instagram located. Pincode and hours unknown.

name: WTF Clothing Rentals
address: Central Arcade, K-2/4, DLF Phase 2, Gurgaon
about: A Gurugram rental store for wedding and party outfits, which also rents accessories and related wedding items.
notes: Address, phone and Instagram handle from LBB; the Instagram profile itself was not fetched. Pincode, hours and prices unknown.

name: Wrapd
address: 22/87, Near Mother Dairy, Block 22, Patel Nagar, New Delhi
about: A Patel Nagar outfit rental store stocking lehengas, gowns and occasion wear for weddings and parties.
notes: Address, phone and starting price from LBB. wrapd.in could not be fetched (expired TLS certificate) so no website is recorded. Pincode and hours unknown.

name: Rent An Attire Villa (RAAV)
address: 2161, Outram Lane, GTB Nagar, New Delhi
about: A North Delhi rental outlet carrying a spread of occasion wear from lehengas through to gowns.
notes: Address, phone and starting price from LBB. Relationship to the national Rent An Attire brand (rentanattire.com) is not confirmed — that site lists no Delhi NCR store address. Pincode, hours and website unknown.

name: Date The Ramp
address: J-34-A, Ground Floor, Lajpat Nagar 2, New Delhi
about: A Lajpat Nagar rental studio offering designer and branded occasion wear on hire.
notes: Address, phone and starting price from LBB and may be dated. No website or Instagram verified. Pincode and hours unknown.
